verses.text: A song of ascents. When the LORD brought people back to Zion, it felt like we were dreaming.
Our mouths filled with laughter, and our tongues with singing. The nations said, “The LORD has done great things for them.”
The LORD has done great things for us, and we’re glad!
LORD, restore what we’ve lost, like streams flowing again in the Negev.
The people who plant in tears will harvest in joy.
The one who heads out crying with seed to plant will come back celebrating, carrying bundles of grain.
